name: voice-processing-system

ground_truth.threatName: Voice Input Stream Denial of Service
ground_truth.description: An attacker could send abnormally large or malformed voice input streams through the API Gateway, potentially overwhelming the system's processing capacity or causing the Lambda functions to crash.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: The attacker exploits the lack of proper input validation and rate limiting by sending large voice files or streaming data that exceeds system processing capabilities.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker writes a script to continuously send large voice files through the API endpoint, consuming Lambda execution time and Kinesis throughput capacity.

ground_truth.attackerPerspective: This is an attractive target as it requires minimal effort to execute and can significantly impact service availability.
ground_truth.defenderPerspective: This vulnerability could lead to increased costs and service disruption for legitimate users.

recommendations.description: Implement request size limits and rate limiting at API Gateway
recommendations.implementationDetails: Configure API Gateway to limit payload size and implement usage plans with throttling limits.

recommendations.description: Add input validation in Lambda functions
recommendations.implementationDetails: Validate voice input size and format before processing. Implement graceful handling of oversized inputs.

recommendations.description: Configure Kinesis Data Streams scaling and monitoring
recommendations.implementationDetails: Set up CloudWatch alarms for Kinesis throughput metrics and implement auto-scaling policies.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: API Gateway provides built-in throttling capabilities. Lambda concurrency limits should be configured appropriately. Consider using AWS WAF for additional protection against DoS attacks.

ground_truth.description: An attacker could exploit vulnerabilities in the Lambda functions to gain unauthorized access to sensitive data and AWS services.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers could exploit vulnerabilities in Lambda function code or dependencies to gain execution control and access AWS resources using the function's IAM role.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker exploits a vulnerability in a dependency used by the Lambda function to execute arbitrary code and access sensitive data in S3 or DynamoDB.

ground_truth.attackerPerspective: Lambda functions with broad permissions are high-value targets as they provide access to multiple AWS services and sensitive data.
ground_truth.defenderPerspective: Compromised Lambda functions could lead to data breaches and unauthorized access to AI/ML services.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Review and restrict Lambda IAM roles to minimum required permissions. Use resource-level permissions where possible.
Enable Lambda code signing, use latest runtimes, implement environment variable encryption, and configure VPC security groups properly.

recommendations.description: Implement security scanning in CI/CD pipeline
recommendations.implementationDetails: Add automated security scanning for dependencies and custom code before deployment.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS Lambda Power Tuning to optimize function configurations. Consider implementing AWS Lambda Extensions for enhanced security monitoring.

ground_truth.description: An attacker could compromise user accounts through credential brute-forcing, weak password policies, or authentication bypass attempts.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers attempt to gain unauthorized access by exploiting weak passwords, brute-forcing credentials, or bypassing authentication mechanisms.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker uses automated tools to attempt login with commonly used passwords or exploits password reset functionality.

ground_truth.attackerPerspective: Authentication systems are primary targets as they control access to the entire application.
ground_truth.defenderPerspective: Compromised accounts could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive voice data and system features.

recommendations.description: Enhance Cognito password policies and MFA
recommendations.implementationDetails: Enable MFA for all users, implement strong password requirements, and add adaptive authentication.
Configure account lockout policies and implement CAPTCHA or similar mechanisms.
Enable Cognito Advanced Security Features for risk-based adaptive authentication.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Consider using Amazon GuardDuty for detecting suspicious authentication attempts. Implement AWS WAF rules to protect against authentication-related attacks.

ground_truth.description: Improper configuration of cross-account access for AI/ML services could lead to unauthorized data access or resource manipulation.

mitreATT&CK: T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Misconfigured service-linked roles (SLRs) or IAM policies could allow unauthorized cross-account access to AI/ML services and data.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker exploits overly permissive cross-account access to exfiltrate voice data or manipulate AI service configurations.

ground_truth.attackerPerspective: Cross-account vulnerabilities provide opportunities for data exfiltration and privilege escalation.
ground_truth.defenderPerspective: Proper isolation between accounts is crucial for maintaining security boundaries and preventing unauthorized access.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Audit and restrict all cross-account IAM roles and resource policies. Remove unnecessary permissions.
Use resource-based policies with explicit deny statements for cross-account access where not needed.
Enable AWS CloudTrail and set up alerts for cross-account access attempts.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use AWS IAM Access Analyzer to identify unintended resource access. Implement AWS Organizations SCPs to enforce account boundaries.

ground_truth.description: An attacker could attempt to manipulate or replace Kinesis streams to intercept or modify voice processing data.

vulnerabilityDetails.howItWorks: Attackers could exploit misconfigured IAM permissions or service endpoints to manipulate Kinesis stream configurations or data.
vulnerabilityDetails.exploitationScenario: An attacker with elevated privileges modifies Kinesis stream settings to redirect data to an unauthorized destination.

ground_truth.attackerPerspective: Stream manipulation could provide access to real-time data and enable man-in-the-middle attacks.
ground_truth.defenderPerspective: Protecting stream integrity is crucial for maintaining the reliability of voice processing operations.

recommendations.implementationDetails: Use IAM policies with condition keys to restrict stream operations and enforce encryption.
Configure detailed CloudWatch metrics and alerts for Kinesis operations and access patterns.
Add validation checks in Lambda functions to verify stream integrity and data source.

ground_truth.awsSpecificConsiderations: Use VPC endpoints for Kinesis to prevent data exposure to the public internet. Implement AWS PrivateLink for secure service communication.

#!/usr/bin/env python3

# AWS Service imports grouped by category
# General
from diagrams.aws.general import Users

# Analytics
from diagrams.aws.analytics import KinesisDataStreams

# Compute
from diagrams.aws.compute import Lambda

# Storage
from diagrams.aws.storage import S3

# Database
from diagrams.aws.database import Dynamodb

# Security
from diagrams.aws.security import Cognito, KMS

# Network
from diagrams.aws.network import APIGateway

# Management
from diagrams.aws.management import Cloudwatch

# Machine Learning
from diagrams.aws.ml import Polly, Transcribe, Lex
from diagrams.aws.ml import Comprehend as ComprehendService

# Core imports
from diagrams import Diagram, Cluster, Edge

# Diagram configuration
graph_attr = {
    "splines": "spline",  # Curved edges
    "nodesep": "0.8",     # Node separation
    "ranksep": "1.0",     # Rank separation
    "pad": "2.0"          # Padding
}

# Create the diagram
with Diagram(
    "Voice Processing System Architecture",
    filename="data/voice-processing-system/architecture",
    direction="TB",
    graph_attr=graph_attr,
    outformat="png",
    show=False
):
    # Define edge styles
    default_edge = Edge(color="black")
    bidirectional = Edge(color="darkgreen", style="dashed")
    labeled_edge = lambda label: Edge(color="blue", label=label)
    
    # End Users
    users = Users("End Users")
    
    # Security and Authentication Layer
    with Cluster("Security & Authentication"):
        security_group = [
            kms := KMS("KMS"),
            cognito := Cognito("Cognito")
        ]
    
    # Frontend Interface
    api = APIGateway("API Gateway")
    
    # Core Processing Layer
    with Cluster("Core Processing"):
        lambda_fn = Lambda("Lambda Functions")
        kinesis = KinesisDataStreams("Kinesis")
    
    # Storage Layer
    with Cluster("Storage & Database"):
        s3 = S3("S3")
        dynamodb = Dynamodb("DynamoDB")
    
    # AI/ML Services Layer
    with Cluster("AI/ML Services"):
        transcribe = Transcribe("Transcribe")
        lex = Lex("Lex")
        comprehend = ComprehendService("Comprehend")
        polly = Polly("Polly")
    
    # Monitoring
    cloudwatch = Cloudwatch("CloudWatch")
    
    # Define connections
    
    # Client-facing connections
    users >> Edge(label="Voice/Text Input") >> api
    api >> Edge(label="Authenticate") >> cognito
    api >> Edge(label="Route Request") >> lambda_fn
    
    # Security connections
    kms >> Edge(color="red") >> [s3, dynamodb, lambda_fn]
    cognito >> default_edge >> lambda_fn
    
    # Core processing connections
    lambda_fn >> bidirectional >> s3
    lambda_fn >> bidirectional >> dynamodb
    lambda_fn >> bidirectional >> kinesis
    
    # AI/ML service connections
    lambda_fn >> labeled_edge("Convert speech to text") >> transcribe
    transcribe >> labeled_edge("Store transcription") >> s3
    lambda_fn >> labeled_edge("Natural language understanding\nIntent matching\nBot interactions") >> lex
    lambda_fn >> labeled_edge("Analyze sentiment\nExtract entities\nDetect key phrases") >> comprehend
    lambda_fn >> labeled_edge("Convert text to speech\nGenerate voice responses") >> polly
    polly >> labeled_edge("Audio response") >> api
    api >> labeled_edge("Voice/Text Response") >> users
    
    # Streaming connections
    kinesis >> default_edge >> lambda_fn
    kinesis >> default_edge >> transcribe
    
    # Monitoring connections
    [api, lambda_fn, s3, dynamodb, kinesis] >> Edge(style="dotted") >> cloudwatch
